rule: Usual test: Mann-Kendall, p < 0.05. Honest verdict: the same test after removing the month-to-month stickiness (lag-1 pre-whitening), p < 0.05.
real_note: Real records are atlas points (NASA POWER, MERRA-2 model) whose trend passes the strictest rule, the map rule (honest test plus false discovery rate control across the whole atlas).
noise_note: Simulated series are trend-free sticky noise (AR(1)) from the simulation lab's generator, with the stickiness and noise size of a real record and the same missing months.
